name: udsm-robots
text:
# robots.txt for lib.udsm.ac.tz (OPAC)
#
# Deployed to /opt/udsm-koha/static/robots.txt and served by the host Apache
# ahead of the reverse proxy, so it costs no Koha worker to serve.
#
# Why this exists: crawlers were issuing 3-7 requests/second against
# opac-search.pl with generated CCL queries, plus opac-export.pl and
# opac-showmarc.pl on every record. Each of those is a Zebra search or a MARC
# render, and on a 4-core box that saturated all CPU and pushed page times from
# 0.2s to 20s. Koha's own README.robots warns about precisely this.
#
# Record pages stay crawlable — that is how patrons find the catalogue from
# Google. What is blocked is the machine-generated query space, which is
# effectively infinite and has no search-result value.

User-agent: *
Crawl-delay: 20

# Infinite/expensive query space — never useful to index
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-search.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-export.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-showmarc.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-ISBDdetail.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-MARCdetail.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-downloadcart.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-downloadshelf.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-sendbasket.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-sendshelf.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-tags.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-shelves.pl

# Patron-facing / authenticated areas
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-user.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-reserve.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-messaging.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-passwd.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-memberentry.pl

# Record detail pages remain allowed on purpose.
Allow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-detail.pl

Sitemap: https://lib.udsm.ac.tz/sitemapindex.xml
